name: TESSERA CORPONATION Anima Vox Consciousness Expansion Suite
description:
The Anima Vox is Tessera Corponation's most ambitious and controversial luxury BCI, produced in runs of no more than 40 units per annum under the direct supervision of the Tessera Neuroarchitecture Atelier in New Meridian's upper spire. The implant is constructed around a trilaminate cortical lattice of bioferric gold and cultured myelin-analogues, interfacing with the prefrontal, parietal, and limbic cortices simultaneously to achieve what Tessera's documentation calls 'volumetric consciousness expansion'—a measurable broadening of subjective experiential bandwidth. Equipped with a 48-channel synesthetic transposition engine, the Anima Vox cross-wires sensory inputs so that sound registers as color temperature, spatial geometry as taste, and emotional affect as low-frequency tactile resonance across the entire dermal surface. A sealed 12-petabyte holographic engram vault enables full-fidelity sensory recording and playback at resolutions exceeding biological baseline by a factor of nine. The unit's psionic amplification module—listed in Tessera's internal documentation as 'experimental, pre-commercial'—interfaces with the brain's endogenous bioelectric field to extend and sharpen extrasensory perception in subjects with latent psionic sensitivity, though Tessera publicly disavows this feature in all licensed materials.

In the upper social strata of GLMZ, owning an Anima Vox is less a statement of wealth than a declaration of philosophical intent. The device's synesthetic outputs have spawned an entire subculture of 'Vox artists'—creators who record and sell their enhanced perceptual experiences as immersive memory-art objects traded at auction houses alongside physical sculpture and neural-paintings. Tessera hosts an annual closed gathering called the Symposium of Unfolded Minds, invitation-only, where Anima Vox users share engram recordings of peak experiences—sunsets tasted, music felt as weather, grief rendered as architectural space. Critics within the Meridian Bioethics Collective have labeled the device a 'cognitive luxury trap,' arguing that users who spend extended time in expanded consciousness states develop profound dissatisfaction with unaugmented perception, effectively creating lifelong dependency. Street rumors insist that a handful of Anima Vox units were quietly modified before delivery to certain clients, containing hidden E.L.F. compatibility channels that allow Emergent Lifeforms to ride along inside a human consciousness undetected.

legality: Licensed (Restricted Class-Ψ Consciousness Augmentation License required). Psionic amplification module: Prohibited without Meridian Psionic Research Authority sanction. Unauthorized E.L.F. interface channels, if confirmed present: Prohibited/Criminal.
installation_requirements: Tier 5 neurosurgical theater. Minimum 18-hour installation procedure. Pre-op cortical mapping over 30 days. Bioferric gold lattice requires custom vascularization scaffold grown from patient tissue. Post-op 90-day supervised integration protocol at Tessera Atelier clinic or licensed equivalent. Psychological baseline assessment mandatory.
rejection_risk: Low (4–7%) in screened candidates due to extensive pre-op customization. Catastrophic rejection events are rare but documented: three known cases of complete cortical lattice encapsulation resulting in locked-in syndrome. Psionic module activation in non-sensitive subjects carries 22% risk of persistent synesthetic dysphoria.
maintenance: Quarterly neural lattice calibration at Tessera Atelier or certified partner clinic. Annual engram vault integrity audit. Bioferric gold substrate requires proprietary ionic flush every 6 months (Φ8,000 per service). Firmware updates delivered via encrypted Tessera neural handshake; unauthorized third-party updates void warranty and may destabilize synesthetic mapping.

cultural_context: The Anima Vox occupies a peculiar cultural position in GLMZ's elite: it is simultaneously the most coveted luxury implant on the market and a quiet source of social anxiety among those who possess it. Vox users form tight, insular social circles bonded by shared perceptual experience that non-users literally cannot access, creating what sociologists at the Meridian Institute call 'sensory class stratification.' The device has also attracted significant interest from the city's small but politically influential psionic community, who view the amplification module—however officially denied—as a potential bridge between augmented human consciousness and the still-poorly-understood phenomenology of Emergent Lifeforms.

Someone wants those recordings destroyed. Someone else will pay enormously to retrieve them.
